title: Rental Vehicle Coordination: Class Rate Schedule
content:
The Rental Vehicle Coordination rate schedule fixes, for each of the six rental classes arranged through the network's national rental partner, the network-negotiated partner daily rate, the weekly rate for a block of seven rental days on a customer-pay rental, the weekly-rate threshold, the fewest rental days billed on any rental, and the discount on customer-pay rentals tied to a network repair.

## Schedule of rates by class

| Rental class | Partner daily rate (USD per rental day) | Weekly rate (USD per block of seven rental days) | Weekly-rate threshold (rental days) | Fewest rental days billed | Customer-pay discount (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Rental | 39.99 | 229.00 | 5 | 1 | 10 |
| Compact Rental | 42.99 | 245.00 | 5 | 1 | 10 |
| Intermediate Rental | 46.99 | 269.00 | 5 | 1 | 10 |
| Full-Size Rental | 52.99 | 299.00 | 5 | 1 | 10 |
| Standard SUV Rental | 64.99 | 379.00 | 5 | 1 | 10 |
| Minivan Rental | 74.99 | 429.00 | 5 | 1 | 10 |

## What each column means

- **Partner daily rate**: the network-negotiated replacement rental rate per rental day for the class.
- **Weekly rate**: the rate for a block of seven rental days on a customer-pay rental.
- **Weekly-rate threshold**: the rental days on a customer-pay rental from which the weekly rate applies to each full seven-day block (a whole number of days).
- **Fewest rental days billed**: the fewest rental days billed on any rental, whatever its length (a whole number of days).
- **Customer-pay discount**: the discount, in percent, on customer-pay rentals tied to a network repair.

Every figure in the schedule belongs to the class reserved or rented; a reservation's class decides which row is read.

## Reading the schedule

- The same weekly-rate threshold of 5 rental days, the same minimum of 1 billed rental day and the same customer-pay discount of 10 percent hold for every class; the partner daily rate and the weekly rate rise with the class, from 39.99 and 229.00 USD for an Economy Rental to 74.99 and 429.00 USD for a Minivan Rental.
- Hypothetical lookup: for a reservation held in the Standard SUV Rental class, the partner daily rate read from this schedule is 64.99 USD and the weekly rate is 379.00 USD; for a Compact Rental the same columns read 42.99 and 245.00 USD.
